metadata.author: John Patrick Green
metadata.description:
Mango and Brash are the InvestiGators: sewer-loving agents of S.U.I.T. and scourge of supervillains everywhere!  In their next big adventure, S.U.I.T. headquarters is under attack, and Mango and Brash are going undercover and underground disguised as city sewer workers to unclog a sticky situation. But when their search for the criminal Crackerdile backfires, the toilets they travel through back up ? and the InvestiGators take the blame for it!  

Can Mango and Brash restore their good name and put the real culprit behind bars before the whole city is in deep water?
